_doc: SIMLI_WIREUP §6 / R4-M7 — source-controlled Sentry alert config. Apply via `sentry-cli alerts apply sentry/alerts/lipsync.json` after `sentry-cli login` (deferred to follow-up if not yet wired in CI). Until then, configure these by hand in the Sentry UI to match.
_two_metrics: We track TWO related metrics (R2-M5 / R4-S clarification): `simli_lipsync_latency_ms` (bridge t1 → first video frame; Simli-health) feeds the 1200ms regression alert. `user_perceived_response_ms` (mic-tap-release → first audio_out; UX) feeds the Phase-E 800ms ship gate but does NOT page on alert (UX measurement, not infrastructure failure).

alerts.name: simli_lipsync_latency_p95_regression
alerts.comment: Floor of 10 sessions/10min prevents single-user noise from paging on day-1 traffic.

alerts.name: simli_video_paused_with_track_high
alerts.comment: R4-YC-Day demo-day failure mode. >2% rate = iOS autoplay rebind regression.

alerts.name: simli_clock_drift_p95_regression
alerts.comment: Threshold raised from R3 200ms to 400ms (above Cartesia's own 187.5ms chunk cadence — R4-S).

alerts.name: simli_mint_replica_not_found_high
alerts.comment: GDPR-erasure / force-retrain race surfaces as replica_not_found mid-session. >3 in 10min = a worker-vs-session race we missed.
